en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing fishermen standing in shallow water and pulling in nets attached to boats near the shoreline. They wear wide-brimmed hats and traditional work clothes. In the background, across a calm bay, is a coastal town with clustered buildings and some larger institutional structures on a low hill, with trees and walls along the waterfront. Printed French caption and a vertical printer's credit are visible, as well as a logo stamp and a modern website watermark.
